id: title:dmarchuk:keep committed progress across a rebalance

review.posthog_relevance: Changes to Kafka consumer offset management and partition-level epoch tracking, potentially improving consistency and preventing duplicate writes or redelivery during consumer rebalancing.

observations.behavior: Adds partition-level epoch tracking and fence, removing global generation-based store skipping; stores offsets only for partitions whose epoch matches dispatch epoch.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents committing offsets for partitions revoked between dispatch and store, while still allowing commits for retained partitions; this preserves group consistency and avoids redelivery or duplicate writes.

observations.behavior: Replaces global generation bump with per-partition epoch bump after drain, and stores offsets only for partitions whose epoch matches dispatch epoch.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows a laggard task to still commit progress on retained partitions while fencing revoked ones, rather than globally skipping all stores after a global generation bump.

observations.behavior: Removes explicit generation parameter from trackTask and storeOffsets, relying on partition-level epoch comparison instead.
observations.posthog_connection: Decouples store decision from global rebalance generation, using partition-specific epoch to determine store eligibility.
